packageRules.description: Wait 7 days after a release before proposing it. Set in a rule so it also replaces the 3 days that config:best-practices sets for npm. Security updates are not delayed.
GitHub Actions updates only once a month.

Do not pin or bump powerhome/argo-diff action references. They float on @main so consumers always run the latest version, and so argo-diff's own references to its composite actions do not cause an endless digest-bump loop.
Keep the kind node image on the same Kubernetes minor as the PAC clusters. Raise when the fleet moves to a newer minor.
